about: Amand.APPs is an indie game development project made with HTML5, focused on small, quick, and fun arcade games that run right in your browser — no downloads, no installs, just click and play.

Every game is handcrafted, from the art to the code, with a lot of care and a healthy dose of nostalgia for classic arcade cabinets. The goal is simple: give people a small moment of fun wherever they are.
Want to follow the project? Check out the social links on the home page or reach out on Discord. Thanks for playing! 🎮
